movies.title: The Debt Collector

movies.tagline: What secrets are you hiding in your phone?
movies.title: Behind the Screens

movies.tagline: The suspect who became a celebrity?
movies.title: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​

movies.overview: Follows the search for a missing military officer in the jungle of Khao Khwang, where legend says man-eating tiger spirit Saming takes human form in 1960s Thailand.
movies.tagline: Prepare to face the evil within the beast.
movies.title: Death Whisperer: Saming the Werebeast

movies.title: My Dearest Assassin

movies.overview: Sao, a talented cook, accidentally meets the man who took advantage of her in the past. She sets her revenge plan in motion using her cooking skill to achieve a rather unexpected result.
movies.title: Morte Cucina

movies.overview: M, a university dropout low on money and luck, volunteers to take care of his terminally ill grandmother, in the hope of pocketing an inheritance.
movies.tagline: Never underestimate a grandma's love for her family.
movies.title: How to Make Millions Before Grandma Dies

movies.tagline: One night, one stain written into a lifetime.
movies.title: The Stain

movies.original_title: โกฮัง..หัวใจโกโฮม
movies.overview: The bonds between humans and animals following a stray dog named Gohan as it moves through life with temporary owners over a decade, through good times and bad times, joy and sorrow, hellos and goodbyes.
movies.tagline: One stray dog, three owners, comes the love that lasts fur-ever.
movies.title: Gohan

movies.title: The Medium

movies.title: Love Syndrome: The Beginning

movies.original_title: ชัตเตอร์ กดติดวิญญาณ
movies.overview: When Jane and Tun run over a girl in a car accident, they speed away immediately from the crime scene. However, Tun, a photographer, soon discovers strange shadows in his photos, which unsettles them.
movies.tagline: The most terrifying images are the ones that are real.
movies.title: Shutter

movies.title: Bang

movies.title: Ong-Bak

movies.original_title: พนอ

movies.title: Panor

movies.original_title: ต้มยำกุ้ง

movies.title: The Protector

movies.original_title: วัยหนุ่ม 2544
movies.overview: Puek, a boy from the slums, had no choice but to endure his circumstances, feeling that he could never have the same worth as others. He remained silent, accepting the bullying of others just to survive in society.
movies.title: In Youth We Trust

movies.original_title: เส้นตาย สายลวง
movies.overview: Three women fall prey to a ruthless phone scam. To settle the score, they'll take on the criminal network that stole their money — and their dignity.

movies.title: The Red Line

movies.original_title: จันดารา

movies.original_title: ลุงบุญมีระลึกชาติ
movies.overview: Suffering from acute kidney failure, Boonmee has chosen to spend his final days surrounded by his loved ones in the countryside. Surprisingly, the ghost of his deceased wife appears to care for him, and his long lost son returns home in a non-human form. Contemplating the reasons for his illness, Boonmee treks through the jungle with his family to a mysterious hilltop cave—the birthplace of his first life.
movies.title: Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives
